description: Image Description: The image displays four bow ties placed on top of a sheet of paper with text. Each bow tie has a distinct design and pattern. The top bow tie is dark blue with a subtle floral pattern. Below it, there is a red bow tie with black stripes. The third bow tie is light gray with black polka dots. The bottom bow tie is gray with a herringbone pattern. The paper underneath the bow ties contains printed text, but it is not fully legible.
